original: Le parc naturel marin des estuaires picards et de la mer d'Opale est un parc naturel marin français créé en décembre 2012. translated: The Parc naturel marin des estuaires picards et de la mer d'Opale is a French marine natural park created in December 2012. It is located in front of the seven coastal rivers, from south to north, the Bresle, the Somme, the Authie, the Canche, the Liane, the Wimereux and the Slack. Its headquarters is located in Écault in the territory of Saint-Étienne-au-Mont, in the Pas-de-Calais.
